subject: Platform failover & registration privacy: ON24/Zoom dual-stream runbook
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: infra@on24.com, zoom-partner@zoom.us, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform failover & registration privacy: ON24/Zoom dual-stream runbook

Hi all,

We need to lock the streaming runbook for DataWave's webinar on 09/23. DataWave has requested both a primary ON24 stream and a Zoom-based fallback stream (for CDN redundancy and to satisfy their internal compliance team). Can each vendor confirm the items below by EOD Thursday? I want to have the rehearsal plan and access details in place by Friday so CS and the client ops team can run through the attendee privacy gating.

Checklist (please confirm status or provide values):
- Primary stream endpoint (ON24): stream key / ingest URL / expected HLS URL
- Fallback stream (Zoom): cloud recording & live stream settings, fallback RTMP endpoint if needed
- Registration fields: which fields are required vs optional; can we hide email from panelist view?
- Recording permissions: explicit attendee consent flow and post-event access (passcode or gated asset?)
- Captions/CC: vendor caption availability & latency expectations
- Failover behavior: how long to wait before switching and whether viewers see a unified player or two separate links
- Test windows: two rehearsals (09/16 and 09/22) — vendor availability?

Attachments: I will upload a short runbook draft to the shared folder after I get confirmations.

Marissa/Dylan: please confirm any Redwood-side constraints (e.g., required registration fields, SSO gating).

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Field Events Manager
Redwood Inference
From: ON24 Infra <infra@on24.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: zoom-partner@zoom.us
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform failover & registration privacy: ON24/Zoom dual-stream runbook

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Primary ON24 ingest: ON24 RTMP ingest available; stream key attached in the PDF (on24_stream_instr.pdf). HLS delivery will be at https://on24-cdn.example.com/datawave/stream.m3u8 (post-event final URL to be provided after encoding completes).
- Registration: ON24 supports custom fields and we can mark fields required. We can hide attendee emails from panelist view; export will still include email for the host.
- Recording permissions: ON24 can enforce a post-event gated asset that requires unique passcode; we can also add a consent checkbox that records acceptance.
- Captions: We support automated captions via partner integration with 3rd-party vendor — latency ~12-15s typical; can enable live captioning if DataWave wants human captions (need 72h notice).
- Failover: We recommend a 30s to 60s buffer before attempting a failover to fallback stream. We publish a unified player when both sources are available; if the fallback is used viewers will remain on the same embed but video source will switch (no change to registrant URL).
- Rehearsals: We are available for a system check on 09/16 10:00-12:00 PT and a final run at 09/22 08:30-10:00 PT.

Attached: on24_stream_instr.pdf (RTMP details + ingestion checklist).

Regards,
Carlos Méndez
Platform Engineer, ON24

[attachment: on24_stream_instr.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, infra@on24.com, zoom-partner@zoom.us
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform failover & registration privacy: ON24/Zoom dual-stream runbook

Stephanie —

Two quick Redwood-side notes:
1) Registration: marketing requires the following fields as mandatory: Full name, Company, Work email. We can add 2 optional fields (Role, Use case) but would prefer to limit optional fields to keep conversion high.
2) Data retention: DataWave's security team asked that raw cloud recording files be retained for 90 days and then auto-deleted unless a retention override is requested. Are both vendors able to auto-delete recordings after 90 days? (This is non-negotiable for the client.)

I'll coordinate SSO/passport info with Dylan.

—Marissa
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: zoom_partner <zoom-partner@zoom.us>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, infra@on24.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform failover & registration privacy: ON24/Zoom dual-stream runbook

Hi team,

Thanks for looping us in. Responses from the Zoom side: 
- Fallback stream: We can provide an RTMP endpoint for live ingestion and also allow cloud live streaming to a third-party CDN. If you want Zoom to be the fallback, we recommend a 45s threshold before auto-failover.
- Cloud recordings: We support retention policies via account settings and can auto-delete after 90 days; we'll need the account admin to confirm the setting (we can provide a snapshot of the setting — see attached zoom_cloud_settings_snapshot.png).
- Captions: Zoom has auto-captioning and supports third-party live caption services; when you enable third-party captions we can pass through CEA-708. Latency is comparable to ON24.
- Access control: Zoom can require a passcode for the live viewing page and also restrict viewing by email domain (useful if DataWave wants only corporate emails).

We uploaded a short checklist to the shared Google Drive folder and created a test meeting link for rehearsals. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_ON24_Zoom_TestPlan

Best,
Lydia Chen
Partner Operations, Zoom
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, infra@on24.com, zoom-partner@zoom.us
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform failover & registration privacy: ON24/Zoom dual-stream runbook

Summary & next steps (finalizing runbook):
- ON24 will be primary. ON24 to provide final HLS URL and confirm passcode gating option (Carlos confirmed).
- Zoom will be configured as fallback with RTMP ingest and cloud recording retention set to 90 days. Zoom to send an account admin snapshot and confirm passcode-by-domain option.
- Registration fields: make Full name / Company / Work email required; Role & Use case optional (as Marissa requested).
- Consent & recording: add explicit consent checkbox on registration in ON24; post-event asset will be gated and require a passcode for download.
- Captions: enable automated captions for both streams; DataWave will advise if they want human captions (72h lead).
- Rehearsals: 09/16 10:00-11:30 PT (system check) and 09/22 08:30-10:00 PT (full run). Please confirm attendance: ON24, Zoom, Marissa, Dylan, and DataWave ops (I will forward registration to them once we lock times).

Deliverables due by Friday EOD:
1) ON24: final HLS URL + gating/passcode flow description + RTMP ingest verification (Carlos)
2) Zoom: account retention snapshot + RTMP endpoint details + rehearsal meeting link (Lydia)
3) Redwood: final registration field config + participant invite list (Marissa/Dylan)

I'll put the runbook draft in the Drive folder and tag everyone's action items. Thanks all — once the deliverables are in, I'll circulate the rehearsal invite and final failover script.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Field Events Manager
Redwood Inference
